{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Remove rows with customer_age == -1
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]

# Check final shape
print(f'Final dataset shape: {df_clean.shape}')

# Check status
print('\nStatus distribution:')
print(df_clean['status'].value_counts())"}
